statement: Is the 1-subdivision of every graph Sidorenko?

source.reference: Conlon, Kim, Lee and Lee (2018), Problem 1.5.

observation: The 2026 counterexample is the incidence graph (1-subdivision) of a 3-uniform hypergraph. Its deficit kernel is regular, so attaching private degree-one vertices to the faces keeps the deficit; hence the k-uniform analogue fails for every k >= 3, while the graph case (k = 2) remains open.
neighbours: Is every bipartite graph of girth at least six Sidorenko?
notes: A known open problem; posting it would restate it.

disposition.reason: Compare with the other candidates of the slate.
